program Main

uses IO

type
    Size = (Small, Large)
    Box = record
        side: Integer

const
    Limit = 10

{ The area of `b`. }
function area(b: Box): Integer
    return b.side * b.side  { square }

let b := Box(side: 2)
writeln("area {area(b)} of {Size.Small}, limit {Limit}")
